subject: NorthBridge POC: scope confirmation & tech asks (embeddings / rerank / streaming funcalls)
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Hall <jordan.hall@northbridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: NorthBridge POC: recap + proposed next steps

Jordan — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap while it's fresh and a short set of asks so we can kick off the POC next week.

What we heard (pain / goals):
- Goal: improve relevance of candidate recommendations in search (CTR uplift target: +12–18%) and reduce manual triage latency from minutes to sub-500ms for top-10.
- Pain: current vector store is slow on multi-pass rerank; infra cost of running dense re-rank at query-time is a blocker.
- Constraint: data cannot leave their VPC for initial POC (they'll provide a VPC peering / private endpoint).

Proposed POC scope (what Redwood will deliver):
1) Embedding pilot: host a small vector index (100k docs) integrated with their vector store — Redwood will provide embedding generation + versioned model.
2) Two-stage rerank: candidate retrieval (existing vector DB) -> Redwood reranker as a low-latency streaming endpoint that supports early-exit.
3) Streaming function-calls for structured output: the reranker will emit JSON payloads (score, categories, confidence) via our structured-output schema.
4) SDK change: a minimal adaptor (we provided a spec) that plugs into their search microservice to call Redwood streaming endpoint and handle incremental responses.

Technical asks from NorthBridge (action items for them):
- Provide sample dataset (5k representative queries + doc ids) and an example query latency profile by Friday 7/2.
- Confirm VPC peering window (they suggested 7/6–7/8).
- Share any PII redaction rules for the docs.

Redwood next steps (owner in parentheses):
- Send a lightweight SOW / POC plan with milestones and SLAs (Ben) — within 24 hours.
- Deliver adaptor proposal and staging deployment checklist (Marissa) — by 7/1 EOD.
- Provision a streaming endpoint and a small dedicated instance for the pilot; validate quantization profile for 8-bit on their hardware shape (Sergio) — by 7/5.

Attachments: streaming-funcalls-adaptor-proposal.pdf (adaptor spec), redwood-poc-metrics.xlsx (suggested KPIs).

Next meeting: propose a 30-min sync Tues 7/6 to confirm VPC details and finalize SOW.

Thanks — happy to iterate if I missed anything.

—
Sergio Alvarez
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132

From: Jordan Hall <jordan.hall@northbridge.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: NorthBridge POC: recap + proposed next steps

Sergio — solid summary, thanks. Confirming a few items from our side.

- Data sample: we can get you 5k queries + doc payloads by 7/2 COB; will strip account IDs per our data handling rules and include a redaction spec.
- VPC peering: agreed on 7/6 at 10:00 PT for initial connectivity test. I'll loop in infra (procurement copied separately).
- KPI: our expectation is top-10 mean latency < 500ms 95th pctl and rerank precision lift target ~15%. We'll treat cost as secondary for the POC.

One addition: we want the streaming reranker to expose partial scores as tokens arrive so our UI can show progressive ranking; is that supported?

Also attached a short compliance checklist our security team expects during the POC (see attachment).

Jordan Hall
Director, Search & Retrieval | NorthBridge AI
jordan.hall@northbridge.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Hall <jordan.hall@northbridge.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NorthBridge POC: recap + proposed next steps

Jordan — thanks for the confirmations and the checklist. Short technical clarifications: 

1) Streaming partial scores: yes — our streaming endpoint can emit intermediate JSON frames with incremental score estimates. We call this "progressive scoring"; client SDKs can subscribe to partial frames and update UI progressively. Note: progressive scoring accuracy converges with final pass; we'll document expected variance in the adaptor spec.

2) Early exit: we can configure confidence thresholds to stop rerank early to meet latency SLOs. We'll include a config set in the adaptor (thresholds + max tokens).

3) KV-cache / quantization note: for the size of the reranker we recommended, we'll run 8-bit quantization but will first validate on your target infra shape (GPU type) — this affects latency and memory headroom. If you need strict reproducible scores for audits we can pin a float32 build for the audit run (costlier).

Attached: redwood-poc-metrics.xlsx — suggested KPIs and measurement plan.

I'll get a draft SOW over in the next 12 hours.

—
Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
